lines.beaver: 안녕하십니까? 오늘은 안보 현안을 짚어 보겠습니다.
lines.beaver_en: Good evening. Today we'll look at security issues.
lines.beaver_roman: annyeonghasimnikka? oneureun anbo hyeonaneul jipeo bogetseumnida.
lines.en: Yes, good evening. Thank you for inviting me.

lines.beaver: 요즘 가장 큰 안보 걱정은 무엇입니까?
lines.beaver_en: What is the biggest security concern these days?
lines.beaver_roman: yojeum gajang keun anbo geokjeongeun mueosimnikka?
lines.learner: 북한의 핵 문제가 가장 큰 걱정입니다.
lines.en: North Korea's nuclear issue is the biggest concern.
lines.roman: bukanui haek munjega gajang keun geokjeongimnida.

lines.beaver: 정부는 이 문제를 어떻게 보고 있습니까?
lines.beaver_en: How does the government see this issue?
lines.beaver_roman: jeongbuneun i munjereul eotteoke bogo itseumnikka?
lines.learner: 정부는 핵 실험에 강하게 대응한 바 있습니다.
lines.en: The government has responded strongly to nuclear tests.
lines.roman: jeongbuneun haek silheome ganghage daeeunghan ba itseumnida.

lines.en: It grew from last year, and much goes to the navy.

lines.beaver_en: What preparations is the navy making?
lines.learner: 작년 하반기에 최신형 배를 들여온 바 있습니다.
lines.en: It brought in the latest ships late last year.
lines.roman: jangnyeon habangie choesinhyeong baereul deuryeoon ba itseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Is there no risk of terrorism?
lines.learner: 작년에 폭탄 테러 위협이 있었지만 막았습니다.
lines.en: Last year there was a bomb threat, but it was stopped.
lines.roman: jangnyeone poktan tereo wihyeobi isseotjiman magatseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Are evacuation drills being carried out well?
lines.learner: 네, 시민들이 빠르게 대피한 바 있습니다.
lines.en: Yes, citizens have evacuated quickly before.
lines.roman: ne, simindeuri ppareuge daepihan ba itseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: That's a relief. Have the police had results too?
lines.learner: 경찰은 납치범을 여러 명 검거한 바 있습니다.
lines.en: The police have arrested several kidnappers.
lines.roman: gyeongchareun napchibeomeul yeoreo myeong geomgeohan ba itseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Do discharged soldiers have a role too?
lines.learner: 제대 후에도 안보 교육에 참여할 수 있습니다.
lines.en: Even after discharge, they can join security education.
lines.roman: jedae huedo anbo gyoyuge chamyeohal su itseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Thank you. Please share a final word.
lines.learner: 모두 안전에 관심을 가져 주십시오. 감사합니다.
lines.en: Please everyone pay attention to safety. Thank you.
lines.roman: modu anjeone gwansimeul gajyeo jusipsio. gamsahamnida.
